header.one_liner: Skyroot Aerospace is an Indian private launch company that achieved the country's first private orbital launch in July 2026.

what_it_is.prose: ISRO states that Skyroot's Vikram-I completed the first private orbital launch from Indian soil on 18 July 2026. Skyroot's own site records the Vikram commercial launch programme, while PIB links the milestone to India's private-space reforms.

deployments_procurement.summary: ISRO states that Skyroot's Vikram-I completed the first private orbital launch from Indian soil on 18 July 2026. Skyroot's own site records the Vikram commercial launch programme, while PIB links the milestone to India's private-space reforms.

faq.question: What did Skyroot achieve?
faq.answer: The first private orbital launch from Indian soil with Vikram-I.

faq.question: What is Skyroot's core business?
faq.answer: Commercial orbital launch vehicles in the Vikram family.

faq.question: Is Skyroot part of India's private-space ecosystem?
faq.answer: Yes; the milestone is tied to the post-2020 private-sector reforms.
